summary: LVMH Hotel Management has acquired both the walls and the business of The 1051 in Ramatuelle, a restaurant, bar and private beach founded in 2018 by Maxime Lamon. The price was not disclosed.
title: LVMH takes a seat on Pampelonne with The 1051
why: Luxury groups now treat the beach club as part of the destination experience; LVMH already runs Cheval Blanc St-Tropez nearby.

visual_text.rest: acquires The 1051, the restaurant and private beach on Pampelonne.
